summary: All three requirements are fully implemented. The diff shows: (1) address validation in SetCoordinatesDialog with required fields and error feedback, (2) zoom controls with ZoomIn/ZoomOut buttons in CommunityMapPanel managing zoom state, and (3) Pin components rendered on the globe with proper 3D positioning and visual distinction.

hallucinated_features.description: Pin hover interactions with cursor changes and scale animations
hallucinated_features.reason: The Pin component implements hover state management (setHovered) and cursor styling changes that were not requested. BuildRequest only required pins to be visible and distinguishable, not interactive hover effects.

hallucinated_features.description: Animated halo effect for selected pins
hallucinated_features.reason: The Pin component includes a haloRef with rotation animation and pulsing scale effect for selected pins. This visual enhancement was not part of the requirements.
Pins dynamically scale based on camera distance using baseScale calculations. The requirement only specified that pins maintain proper 3D positioning, not adaptive scaling based on zoom level.

hallucinated_features.description: Different pin colors for current user vs other users
hallucinated_features.reason: Pin component distinguishes current user with green color (#10b981) vs other users with red/blue. BuildRequest only required pins to be distinguishable from globe surface, not user-specific color coding.

hallucinated_features.description: Metalness and emissive material properties for pins
hallucinated_features.reason: Pins use meshStandardMaterial with metalness, roughness, emissive, and emissiveIntensity properties for visual polish. Basic visibility was the only requirement.
